text: DSH Theme Gallery 是面向 DSH 网页客户端的视觉主题画廊插件。它在侧边栏加入视觉风格入口，打开后可为应用切换 Pixel Arcade 或 Aurora Whispers 外观，也可恢复原生主题。插件通过主题 token 覆盖和样式表应用风格，并将选择保存在当前浏览器中，刷新后恢复。适合希望调整 DSH 整体外观、并在浅色和深色模式间沿用对应配色的用户。使用时不需要额外密钥或外部账号。

DSH Theme Gallery adds a visual style gallery to the DSH web sidebar. Choose Pixel Arcade or Aurora Whispers for the app, or restore its native look. Styles use theme tokens and CSS; the selected style is saved in this browser and restored after reload. No API key or external account is needed.
想给 DSH 换成像素风或极光风的整体主题。
How can I switch my DSH app to a different visual theme?
DSH Theme Gallery 的功能「切换应用视觉风格」：在侧边栏打开视觉风格画廊，选择 Pixel Arcade 或 Aurora Whispers 后立即应用，也可恢复原生外观。选择保存在当前浏览器，重新载入后可恢复。

@joxos/dsh-theme-gallery README · DSH Theme Gallery (`@joxos/dsh-theme-gallery`)：A DeepSeek Harness bundle that adds a **Visual style** entry to the left sidebar
and opens a page where the whole application can be re-skinned.

Two styles, each with a light and a dark palette that follow the host's
color-scheme preference:

@joxos/dsh-theme-gallery README · DSH Theme Gallery (`@joxos/dsh-theme-gallery`)：| id | 中文 | English | Signature |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `pixel` | 像素街机 | Pixel Arcade | zero corner radius, monospace type, high-contrast arcade palette |
| `cyber` | 极光絮语 | Aurora Whispers | near-transparent glass, opaque composer, drifting aurora, large flowing aurora blobs |

`Use native` (恢复原生) removes the active layer and returns to the shipped
theme untouched.

@joxos/dsh-theme-gallery README · Design notes：Both styles intervene beyond color: translucent panels over drifting body
gradients, per-style elevation/glow tokens, texture and overlay layers,
typography and geometry. Visual directions are inspired by:

* `pixel` — 8-bit arcade cabinets and CRT pixel art.
* `cyber` — northern-lights photography, TRON: Legacy glow, Linear/Vercel dark precision.

@joxos/dsh-theme-gallery README · Design notes：Aurora Whispers' slow aurora drift, gel sway and pulse, and its always-on FX
overlay (large flowing aurora blobs) are part of that style's identity and run
even when the OS disables animations; pick another style if you need a still
interface. Gradients are rendered by CSS (no assets), and every effect is
removed with the style layer.

@joxos/dsh-theme-gallery README · How it works：* **Palette** — the page calls `theme.overrideTokens(source, tokens)`. The
  override layer stores a `{ light, dark }` pair per token, so switching the
  host's light/dark preference keeps working. No theme is registered and the
  user's Appearance choice is never rewritten.
* **Shape and type** — no alias token covers corner radii or the text font, so
  each style appends a small stylesheet (one `<style>` tag owned by the
  plugin's effect) that sets `--dsw-radius-*`, the text font stack, and
  per-style elevation/glow variables.
* **Surface and motion** — Aurora Whispers paints the page body with
  per-scheme gradients, translucent panel tokens, slow drift, and a
  pointer-events-none FX overlay of flowing aurora blobs. Pixel Arcade forces
  zero radii and a monospace stack. Everything is CSS-only, scoped to the
  active style, and removed with that style.
* **Persistence** — the selected id is kept in `localStorage` under
  `dsh.style-gallery.active`. The client half is `immediately: true`, so a page
  reload restores the style before the gallery is opened again.

@joxos/dsh-theme-gallery README · Development：Requirements: Node.js 18+ and pnpm.

```bash
pnpm install
pnpm build   # src/client -> client.js
pnpm check   # manifest, patch name, locale, icon, built artifact
pnpm test    # VM smoke test: slots, restore, token layer, disposal

Edit `src/client`, never the generated `client.js`. `pnpm build` also injects
the package name as the browser module id, so a rename cannot leave the bundle
registered under a stale name.

@joxos/dsh-theme-gallery README · Development：```text
src/client/
├─ index.js          module-loader entry (registers the lazy factory)
├─ plugin.js         locale, theme layer, stylesheet and slot registration
├─ constants.js      namespace, panel id, storage key, effect style

@joxos/dsh-theme-gallery README · Install：Local checkout: install the folder through the Plugin Manager (`install_bundle`
with this directory). The Host row only exists so the bundle is a normal profile
entry; all behavior is in the browser half.

From npm:

```powershell
dsh plugin add @joxos/dsh-theme-gallery
```

Or use Plugin Manager → Add plugin and enter the package name.

@joxos/dsh-theme-gallery README · Publishing：The package is published as `@joxos/dsh-theme-gallery`. The GitHub Actions
workflow at [`.github/workflows/publish.yml`](.github/workflows/publish.yml)
publishes a new version on a `v*` tag or a manual workflow run. It needs an
`NPM_TOKEN` repository secret.

@joxos/dsh-theme-gallery README · Files：| Path | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `index.js` | Host half (empty `apply`), required by the patch row |
| `src/client/**` | Browser source modules |
| `client.js` | Generated browser artifact served by the Host |
| `scripts/build-client.mjs` | Bundles `src/client` into `client.js` |
| `scripts/check.mjs` | Validates the manifest, patch row, locales, icon and artifact |
| `scripts/check-publish.mjs` | Rejects `private` and `@local` before publishing |
| `scripts/smoke-test.mjs` | Exercises the built bundle in a VM harness |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Inserts the `dsh-theme-gallery` row |
| `locale/{en,zh}.json` | Plugin Manager title/description |
| `icon.svg` | Plugin artwork (palette glyph) |
| `.github/workflows/publish.yml` | Tag/manual npm publish workflow |
